title: What a bathroom scale reports is Earth's tug on you
summary: Weight is the name NASA Space Place gives to Earth's combined tug on every bit of a person's body.
body: The Space Place gravity article says our planet's tug comes from the whole of its bulk acting together. That combined tug, acting on the bulk of a person, is what the page calls weight. A scale is the everyday reader of that tug. The article does not print the conventional standard figure used in unit tables. Article date on the page: 17 December 2020.

sources.title: What Is Gravity?
sources.author: NASA Space Place
sources.note: NASA Space Place, article last updated 17 December 2020. Paraphrase of the page's own sentence. Public-domain US federal page. Supports the sentence that the combined pull on the mass in your body is what gives you weight.
